verdict.rationale: Stagehand is itself a developer SDK. Its docs say it offers familiar APIs across TypeScript, Python, and Go, and its CrewAI integration explicitly wraps 'the Stagehand Python SDK', with a quickstart and AI coding-assistant rules that support building against it. missing for 10: per-language SDK reference depth (e.g., Go parity details), independent hands-on corroboration of the non-TypeScript SDKs.
